title: Dependency graph validation tool with cycle detection
description: Create a new script validate-backlog-graph.js that reads all backlog items for a project, builds a directed graph from depends_on and parent_id edges, and validates it is a DAG. The tool must detect and reject dependency cycles, reporting the cycle path. It must also validate parent_id references (parent must exist, parent must be type 'epic', no self-reference). Output is JSON: { ok, project_id, nodes, edges, cycles, parent_errors, warnings }. Add a shell wrapper tools/validate-backlog-graph.sh. Create output schema validate-backlog-graph.output.schema.json.
stop_condition: Cycle detection works on synthetic graphs. Parent_id references are validated. Output matches schema. Tests registered in test-all.sh.
